record.question: Who is the first Chief Minister of Telangana State?
record.explanation: Answer A: K.Chandrasekhar. K. Chandrashekar Rao was sworn in as the first Chief Minister of Telangana on 2 June 2014. Parliament's original historical journal records the inauguration. The shortened printed K.Chandrasekhar is unambiguous among these names. Historical/source note: Printed option A abbreviates the name; the full name is K. Chandrashekar Rao. Reference: https://sansad.in/uploads/JPI_september2014_E_3ca32160c8.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
